action_items: No action required for the drop-add-player-toast feature — all tests pass.

critical_code_review_comments: Team.tsx now 772 lines — nearing the >700-line threshold. Recommend extracting the drop-confirmation toast JSX and the sticky drop-add-player-toast JSX into small presentational components (e.g., DropConfirmToast, DropAddPlayerToast) to keep handleDropPlayer readable.

openSlots math in handleDropPlayer uses `(selectedTeam?.roster_count ?? 1) - 1`. The default of 1 is safe (produces 0 when roster_count missing, but still respects max(0,...)). Consider guarding on `selectedTeam?.roster_count != null` explicitly to avoid computing a sticky toast when team state hasn't loaded.
Magic number fallback: `Number((league as any)?.roster_spots ?? 25)`. Pull 25 into a named constant (DEFAULT_ROSTER_SPOTS) or fail loudly if league isn't loaded.
`(league as any)` cast bypasses TS — add a typed roster_spots field on the League interface.
